drums.tags: Stomp and clap folk percussion track. The arrangement consists of heavy, resonant foot stomps on beats 1 and 3, layered with crisp hand claps on beats 2 and 4. A tambourine provides high-frequency accents on the backbeat. A wooden block or rimshot-style percussion hits syncopated eighth-note patterns. The tempo is 110 BPM in 4/4 time. The mix is dry with minimal room reverb, emphasizing the organic, acoustic texture of the rhythmic elements. The dynamics are consistent throughout, maintaining a steady, driving pulse without melodic or harmonic accompaniment.
drums.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[heavy foot stomps on beats 1 and 3]
[hand claps on beats 2 and 4]

[Main Rhythm]
[tambourine accents on backbeat]
[syncopated wood block hits]
[steady driving stomp-clap pattern continues]

bass.tags: Hardcore punk. Distorted electric guitar plays rapid down-stroked power chords in a constant eighth-note rhythm. The bass guitar follows the guitar progression with a thick, overdriven tone. Drums feature a fast d-beat pattern with a prominent, uncompressed snare and constant eighth-note hi-hat hits. Vocals are shouted with a raspy, aggressive delivery and minimal melodic variation. The recording has a raw, lo-fi aesthetic with high-frequency saturation. Key of E minor. 180 BPM. 4/4 time signature.
